text:
Lena (CS): Heads-up — Aquamark onboarding: noticed steady increase in p95 on their 'agent-chat' route after turning on autoscaling; cost rising too. Renewal check-in in 10 days. Thinking proactive play: mixed-precision int4 for scoring shards, split traffic: small model for quick suggestions, large for final outputs, and route by cost/latency. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Arjun (SE): Good call. Quick sketch:
- Canary int4 on scoring only (10%)
- Route 'suggest' -> rwd-3-micro, 'finalize' -> rwd-3-large-fp16
- Add session tag 'low-latency' to prefer dedicated if warm
- Enable short-term KV prefix caching for repeat prompts

Priya (Eng-ML): +1. Checklist:
1) Gather 300 representative queries from their prod logs (I'll help filter for sensitive data).
2) Run automated eval: LM score + task-specific metric (F1 for entity extraction).
3) Canary config (example as flat text):
policy=percentage_canary;percent=10;map[suggest]=rwd-3-micro-int4;map[finalize]=rwd-3-large-fp16;fallback=rwd-3-large-fp16

Kai (Solutions): Capture 5 customer-critical golden examples (must-match). They will reject any noisy truncation. Also want a short note for renewal owner about risk mitigations.

Lena (CS): I'll request golden prompts and flag them as must-pass. Priya, can we set an auto-rollback threshold if entity F1 drops >1.5% or if customer error reports spike?

Priya (Eng-ML): Yes — we'll wire alerts: eval-delta >1.5% OR customer-err-rate >1.2x -> rollback. Also track tokenization diffs for int4.

ci-bot: Canary started: aquamark/suggest -> rwd-3-micro-int4 (10%). Canary ID canary-4367890123-AQ.

Arjun (SE): I'll prepare routing policy (pseudo):
route: interactive
match: session.tags contains 'low-latency'
action: prefer [dedicated-us-east, hosted-lowcost];slo:200ms

Priya (Eng-ML): Plan to post eval plot in 6-8 hours. If looks clean, expand to 30% and enable prefix cache.

Lena (CS): Perfect. Next steps: Kai collect golden prompts; Priya run evals + set rollback hooks; Arjun draft routing policy; I'll inform renewal owner. Ping me with any customer sign-off notes. :satellite:

ci-bot: Canary report: first 250 requests — p95 270ms on canary, overall cost down ~8%, no must-pass failures so far. Monitoring continues.
